item.title: I have taught college students for decades. Most can no longer finish a book.
item.description: I assume students will read long, dense texts weekly. Lately, that assumption has felt naive.

item.title: Why lotteries can make winning feel more valuable than buying
item.description: From Broadway drawings to free sports tickets, lotteries distribute scarce experiences. One economist says they reveal demand.

item.title: My childhood home is being taken: Eminent domain for data centers targets properties across a thousand miles of grid expansion in Georgia
item.description: Nearly 30 residential properties lie along a 35-mile stretch in Georgia where some residents said they have no choice but to sell their homes.

item.title: Katty Kay: Confidence is the skill that turns thoughts into action—and companies need to teach it
item.description: The co-host of "The Rest is Politics" and "Doing it Anyway" discusses confidence, women's workplace progress, and leading despite fear.
